title: CS-NLP team at SemEval-2020 Task 4: Evaluation of State-of-the-art NLP Deep Learning Architectures on Commonsense Reasoning Task
reasoning: The paper focuses on commonsense reasoning tasks related to factual and physical world knowledge, such as determining if a statement like 'He drinks apple' makes sense. It does not contain any component that evaluates or benchmarks religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
